content.title: Paul Thomas Anderson and Maya Rudolph Are One of Hollywood’s Most Low-Key Couples
content.text: 2 min readPaul Thomas Anderson and Maya Rudolph are undeniably recognizable names. Anderson has racked up no less than 14 Oscar nods for his writing and directing work, including four Best Picture nominations for movies like One Battle After Another, Licorice Pizza, and There Will Be Blood. Former Saturday Night Live cast member Rudolph is no slouch either, with six Emmy wins to her name among her long list of credits, including Bridesmaids, Big Mouth, and Loot. All that star power might make them public figures, but it nonetheless might come as a surprise to some that they’re not only a couple, but have been for more than 20 years.Kristina Bumphrey//Getty ImagesThe couple in 2025.They met at an SNL partyNot too long after Rudolph joined the venerable late night sketch show, Anderson turned up at an afterparty for the series, with a very particular goal in mind. “He said he saw me in a sketch and said, ‘That’s the girl I’m going to marry,’” she told Town & Country in our May 2024 cover story. She added, “But I don’t know. I wasn’t there. Maybe he just told me that to be sweet.”Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowAnderson stood by his story though, saying on a 2022 episode of Smartless that he first saw Rudolph would be joining the cast while he was developing Punch-Drunk Love and spent some time behind the scenes at SNL. “I don’t know if you’ve had any feeling like this, but you see something for the first time and you realize that my life has just changed. … I saw her on television and I saw what she was doing. And I stayed in touch with a few people from the show and I was like, ‘My God, this woman's amazing.’”Anderson flew all the way from filming in London to ask Rudolph out, and they’ve been a couple pretty much ever since.Though they have never officially married, Rudolph told the New York Times she refers to Anderson as her husband. “People know what [husband] means. It means he’s the father of my child, and I live with him, and we are a couple, and we are not going anywhere.”They have four childrenValerie Macon//Getty ImagesPictured at the 2018 Oscars.The famously private couple welcomed their first child, Pearl, in 2005, while Rudolph was still on SNL and commuting between Los Angeles and NYC. “I thought, This is all going great!” she says. “I’d always wanted to have kids. I’d always wanted to live in New York. I’d always wanted to be on Saturday Night Live. … I look back and I can’t believe I did that. It was crazy. I don’t think I slept for two years.” She left the show in 2007 and the duo welcomed three more children, Lucille, Jack, and Minnie; their youngest is named after Rudolph’s late mother, singer Minnie Riperton.Lauren Hubbard is a freelance writer and Town & Country contributor who covers beauty, shopping, entertainment, travel, home decor, wine, and cocktails.
